verdict: Kraft Heinz's sales slipped 2% to $6.12B and operating income fell 15% to $875M as North America volumes declined — though Emerging Markets grew 14% and net income came in at $536M.

kpis.label: Gross margin
kpis.note: +60 bp YoY on pricing and productivity

segments.name: North America
segments.note: The biggest market shrank 3.4% — meats, sauces and refreshment beverages lost volume, and about 80 bp of the decline was an inventory pull-forward into Q2.

segments.name: Europe & Pacific Developed Markets
segments.note: Developed markets outside North America declined 5.6%.

segments.name: Emerging Markets
segments.note: The growth engine — sales up 13.8%, with organic growth of 15.6% on stronger pricing and volumes.

opex.name: Selling, general and administrative
opex.note: Marketing, distribution overhead and the back office — including $72M of goodwill and intangible impairment charges this quarter ($69M goodwill, $3M intangibles).

otherDetail: Net interest expense of $210M on the company's debt stack, partly offset by $39M of other income.

takeaways.title: Volumes keep sliding at home
takeaways.text: Organic sales fell 1.1% — price was flat while volume/mix declined, led by North America meats, sauces and beverages.

takeaways.title: Emerging Markets is the bright spot
takeaways.text: Organic sales grew 15.6% in Emerging Markets, the only segment growing — now $720M of the quarter's sales.

takeaways.title: The big split is on hold
takeaways.text: Work on the previously announced separation of Kraft Heinz into two public companies is currently paused, the company disclosed, even as it updated its 2026 outlook.

oneTimers: The quarter includes $72M of goodwill and intangible impairment charges. The nine-month picture is much heavier: $2.51B of goodwill and $4.93B of intangible impairments taken earlier in 2026 are why year-to-date results show a net loss.
footerNote: Net income attributable to common shareholders was $544M (a small loss was attributable to noncontrolling interests), the basis for the $0.46 diluted EPS.
